name: Boiler registration — capacity, pressure and temperature all required

source.instrument: Indian Boiler Regulations, 1950; Directorate of Steam Boilers Maharashtra

note: v1 checked capacity alone and would have wrongly required registration for a 500 litre hot water generator at 80C. s.2(b) excludes a vessel if capacity <25L OR pressure <1 kg/cm2 OR water heated below 100C, so inclusion requires all three.

name: Hot water generator — no registration required
note: Where water is heated below 100C the equipment is a hot water generator, not a boiler. Active exclusion, so it outranks an indeterminate requires.
